source.table: Table 5. Outlays of the U.S. Government, May 2026 and Other Periods
source.title: Corps of Engineers section (Table-5 cap-fit unit, page 18). Full 9-column outlays model. Flat section; single-source Applicable column (only Proprietary Receipts). Self-contained. Family pattern: plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md; worked examples: -legislative, -judicial, -state, -commerce.
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted; Harbor Maintenance Trust Fund reports only the Prior-FYTD period); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' -- omitted (Intrabudgetary Prior Gross/Net). Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Nine-column model: 3 periods x (Gross Outlays / Applicable Receipts / Outlays[net]). The Applicable column has a single contributing line (Proprietary Receipts), so it has no >=2-source roll-up: the 3 section-total Applicable cells are covered by the total-row net identity (Total Outlays + Total Applicable = Total Gross), and the 3 line-level Proprietary Applicable cells are 'standalone' with a why (see -judicial and the plan's Pattern addendum). Non-default tolerances quote the Table-5 rounding note (p. 23): 'Note: Details may not add to totals due to rounding.'

cells.why: Applicable Receipts on 'Proprietary Receipts from the Public', a line with no Gross Outlays (Gross column '......'): Outlays(net) = -Applicable, but the offset has no Gross cell to target and Proprietary is the only line carrying an Applicable value in this section (single-source column, no >=2-source roll-up). Relation-free within this unit; the section-total Applicable cell (same value) is instead covered by the total-row net identity.
